name: Enterprise Software Product and Provenance
constraints: WM-SFT-001 owns durable Software Product identity, delivery model, offering lineage, licensing, support and conformity context.
WM-SFT-007 owns Component or Package identity, WM-SFT-008 owns Build, Release and Artifact provenance, and WM-SFT-009 owns Deployment occurrences.
WM-SFT-003 owns independent API or Interface Contract revisions, providers, consumers and endpoint bindings.
WM-SFT-012 remains the SBOM document master and SBOM Reference is a typed reference rather than a model.
AISMM 3.1.0 supplies aligned product-knowledge projections with provenance and never becomes a second product master.
Build execution, release state, artifact bytes and deployment occurrence remain distinct across SaaS, library, on-prem and container delivery profiles.
holds: Canonical completion and approved relation rows for several WM-SFT bases remain pending.
SaaS no-artifact and firmware or OTA fixtures require further frozen audit.
